facts.claim: PhonePe earns merchant interchange of 0.5% to 1.1% on eligible flows, with lending distribution at 11.55% of first-half FY26 revenue
facts.source_title: PhonePe IPO India 2026: Valuation, OFS Structure, NPCI Cap Risk
facts.excerpt: PhonePe's revenue comes from merchant interchange (0.5%-1.1% on eligible flows), device subscriptions, bill-payment commissions and lending distribution at 11.55% of H1 FY26 revenue.

facts.claim: UPI runs on zero merchant discount rate as a national policy decision
facts.source_title: PhonePe IPO India 2026: Valuation, OFS Structure, NPCI Cap Risk
facts.excerpt: UPI operates on zero MDR, a policy decision made at the national level, which constrains direct payment transaction monetization.

facts.claim: India's leading UPI app earns roughly 112 rupees of gross revenue per registered user per year
facts.source_title: PhonePe IPO India 2026: Valuation, OFS Structure, NPCI Cap Risk
facts.excerpt: The category leader generates approximately Rs 112 of gross revenue per registered user per year.

facts.claim: PhonePe's FY26 operating revenue rose 11% to 7,920 crore rupees with a net loss of 2,792 crore, against Paytm's 8,437 crore revenue and 552 crore profit

facts.claim: More than 120 million UPI Autopay mandates are created every month in India
facts.source_title: UPI Autopay vs Card e-Mandates: 2026 Decision Guide
facts.excerpt: Over 120 million UPI Autopay mandates are created every month in India, supporting SIPs, OTT subscriptions and insurance renewals.
